<!--
  THE EXPERIMENT FIGURE. Sits between the character-count slides and
  fig-tokens.png, and its only job is to make the measurement legible before
  the numbers land: what, exactly, was asked for in each condition.

  ONE PICTURE, TWO STATES, NOT TWO PICTURES. Click 0: the agent emits the
  finished artifact and that is the end of the chain. Click 1: the title swaps
  and a .qmd box appears in the middle of every chain. The agent box and the
  three output icons NEVER MOVE across the click -- the endpoints are the
  constant, and the only thing that changes is what happens between them. That
  is the whole argument, so it has to be the only thing that animates.

  What actually swaps: a `fragment fade-out` group (state-A title + the three
  long curves) and a `fragment` group (state-B title + three .qmd boxes + six
  short arrows), both on data-fragment-index="1" so one click does both.
  Everything outside those two groups is shared and unfragmented.

  ONE AGENT BOX, THREE CHAINS. `data/token_results.csv` has `quarto_html`,
  `quarto_pdf` and `quarto_word` as three separate rows: each was its own run,
  producing its own .qmd -- hence three .qmd boxes, not one fanning out to three
  outputs. The single agent box is ink economy, not a claim that one run made
  all three: the agent is what does NOT vary between conditions, so drawing it
  three times would say the opposite of what the figure means. (The csv also
  carries a `markdown` condition in both halves; the figure shows the three
  formats the character-count slides use.)

  THE FANS ARE CUBIC BEZIERS WITH HORIZONTAL TANGENTS AT BOTH ENDS, so every
  arrowhead lands pointing right, into the side of the box it feeds, the same
  way the straight middle row does. A raw diagonal into an icon reads as a
  poke; the S-curve reads as a branch. Middle row is a plain line because at
  dy=0 the curve degenerates anyway.

  There are deliberately NO labels on the arrows. Six of them ("writes",
  "render", three times over) is more ink than the difference is worth, and the
  heading already names the two verbs: the ITALIC *render* in "Ask for the .qmd,
  render the artifact" is the step the agent doesn't do. Fira Sans Condensed is
  loaded with its italic axis (lexis.scss imports `ital,wght@0,…;1,…`), so that
  is a real italic and not a synthesised slant.

  THE THREE OUTPUT ICONS ARE FONT AWESOME WEBFONT GLYPHS, not paths:
  `Font Awesome 6 Free` at weight 900 for the solid file icons (\f1c1 pdf,
  \f1c2 word) and `Font Awesome 6 Brands` at 400 for html5 (\f13b). The font is
  already on the page because the three character-count slides use the `fa`
  shortcode; if those ever go, this figure turns to tofu, which is why every
  icon also carries a text label beside it.

  NB: do not write a bare `fa` shortcode anywhere in this comment. Quarto's
  shortcode pass scans raw HTML blocks, comments included, and an argument-less
  one crashes fontawesome.lua at `stringify(args[1])`.

  THE .qmd IS QUARTO'S OWN MARK, drawn as a path rather than a glyph. The
  iconify extension renders `simple-icons:quarto` as a Web Component, which
  cannot live inside an SVG, so the path is copied in at 24x24 and scaled to 52
  units. It is the same artwork the `quarto` shortcode paints on the
  character-count slide. All three .qmd boxes are identical — one `<use>` of one
  def — because the source is the same object in all three conditions; only what
  comes out of the render differs.

  COLORS are the cost slides' ramp, NOT the content/format chips: Quarto blue,
  amber PDF, red HTML, Word blue. Same order, same colours, so this slide and
  the character counts agree. The mark wears Quarto's brand #74aadb; the letters
  beside it wear the darker twin, because #74aadb is 2.5:1 on white. The
  entanglement figure's yellow/teal vocabulary is deliberately absent — this
  slide is about what was measured, not about what is fused to what.

  GEOMETRY, so edits stay on the grid. Rows at y 300 / 450 / 600. Agent box
  x 60..400, centred on y=450, so the middle chain is dead straight and the
  other two mirror it. Arrows leave a box at +2 and land 14 short of the next
  one (arrowhead sits in that gap); off the agent every fan starts from the one
  point (402, 450). .qmd boxes x 660..866. Every arrowhead lands at x=956; the
  icon centre is +53 from there and its label +100, which is the deck's usual
  offset scaled to this size. Stroke is 3.5 and the marker is markerUnits=
  strokeWidth, so the heads grew with it. Marker id is unique document-wide
  (`ahExp`) because reveal display:none's non-current slides.

  THE viewBox wraps the ink with an even gutter: the drawing measures
  x 60..1165, y 97..646 (getBBox), so "10 52 1204 639" leaves ~50 units either
  side and ~45 above and below. 85vh matches the other figures in `svg/`.
-->

```{=html}
<svg viewBox="10 52 1204 639" width="100%" style="max-height:85vh;"
     xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     font-family="'Fira Sans Condensed', Tahoma, sans-serif">

  <defs>
    <marker id="ahExp" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="5.5" refY="3"
            orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L7,3 L0,6 z" fill="#2e4057"/></marker>

    <!-- The .qmd, in the entanglement figure's box — same white fill, same navy
         stroke, same rounded rect — because it is the same object: a FILE, not a
         format, which is why the container is neutral rather than blue. The box
         is also what stops the source from reading as a second output icon.
         Hung on the row's centreline, so each row just translates it. -->
    <g id="qmdBox">
      <rect x="660" y="-46" width="206" height="92" rx="8"
            fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3.5"/>
      <g transform="translate(678 -26) scale(2.16667)">
        <path fill="#74aadb" d="M12.65 12.854V24c6.042-.325 10.923-5.105 11.33-11.125H12.65Zm-1.504 0H.02c.427 5.94 5.166 10.699 11.105 11.105V12.854Zm1.505-1.505H24C23.675 5.247 18.753.325 12.65 0Zm-1.505 0V0C5.106.427.326 5.308 0 11.35Z"/>
      </g>
      <text x="746" y="0" font-size="36" dominant-baseline="central"
            fill="#3d7fb5" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.qmd</text>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- ============ shared: the agent, and the three outputs ============ -->

  <!-- Same dashed rounded rect as the entanglement figure: the dash is the
       stochastic step. Drawn once, and it does not move on the click. -->
  <rect x="60" y="395" width="340" height="110" rx="8"
        fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3.5"
        stroke-dasharray="9 7"/>
  <text x="230" y="450" font-size="40" text-anchor="middle"
        dominant-baseline="central" fill="#2e4057">LLM agent</text>

  <text x="1009" y="300" font-size="68" text-anchor="middle"
        dominant-baseline="central" fill="#A77400"
        font-family="'Font Awesome 6 Free'" font-weight="900">&#xf1c1;</text>
  <text x="1056" y="300" font-size="36" dominant-baseline="central"
        fill="#A77400" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.pdf</text>

  <text x="1009" y="450" font-size="68" text-anchor="middle"
        dominant-baseline="central" fill="#d1495b"
        font-family="'Font Awesome 6 Brands'" font-weight="400">&#xf13b;</text>
  <text x="1056" y="450" font-size="36" dominant-baseline="central"
        fill="#d1495b" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.html</text>

  <text x="1009" y="600" font-size="68" text-anchor="middle"
        dominant-baseline="central" fill="#2B579A"
        font-family="'Font Awesome 6 Free'" font-weight="900">&#xf1c2;</text>
  <text x="1056" y="600" font-size="36" dominant-baseline="central"
        fill="#2B579A" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.docx</text>

  <!-- ============ state A: ask for the artifact ============ -->

  <g class="fragment fade-out" data-fragment-index="1">
    <text x="60" y="150" font-size="56" font-weight="600" fill="#2e4057">Ask for the artifact directly</text>

    <path d="M 402 450 C 620 450, 738 300, 956 300" fill="none"
          stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3.5" marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
    <path d="M 402 450 L 956 450"
          stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3.5" marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
    <path d="M 402 450 C 620 450, 738 600, 956 600" fill="none"
          stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3.5" marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ state B: ask for the .qmd ============ -->

  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1">
    <text x="60" y="150" font-size="56" font-weight="600" fill="#2e4057">Ask for the .qmd, <tspan font-style="italic">render</tspan> the artifact</text>

    <!-- The same fan, cut short at the .qmd, then one straight arrow out of it.
         The chain got a stop in the middle; it did not get rerouted. -->
    <path d="M 402 450 C 500 450, 548 300, 646 300" fill="none"
          stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3.5" marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
    <path d="M 402 450 L 646 450"
          stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3.5" marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
    <path d="M 402 450 C 500 450, 548 600, 646 600" fill="none"
          stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3.5" marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>

    <g transform="translate(0 300)">
      <use href="#qmdBox"/>
      <path d="M 868 0 L 956 0" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3.5"
            marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(0 450)">
      <use href="#qmdBox"/>
      <path d="M 868 0 L 956 0" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3.5"
            marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(0 600)">
      <use href="#qmdBox"/>
      <path d="M 868 0 L 956 0" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3.5"
            marker-end="url(#ahExp)"/>
    </g>
  </g>

</svg>
```
